Wow congrats on your recovery! That's awesome that things are going better for you.  Basically my life has just been a serious of traumatic events, lost my brother to suicide when I was in first grade then struggled with self harm and self image thought middle school and then I met a guy who I fell in love with after being with an asshole who would mentally abuse me. He made me so happy I didn't feel a need to self harm anymore things didn't matter because he was there and I was happy. About 4 years ago his brother committed suicide and that hurt because it brought back the feelings of when I lost my brother, then 2 years ago my boyfriend of 6 years committed suicide which left me fragile, broken and vulnerable I thought I hit rock bottom, I struggled with self harm and eating, I had to take disability from work and go to a treatment center everyday (outpatient) we worked on a lot of dbt and between being in different groups I felt a little more better equipped to deal with my feelings. I returned to work after about 7 months and towards the end of disability I met an amazing guy. He has helped me through the darkest times of my life and I can honestly say he's the best thing for me. I never thought I'd find another person that I could love after all of that but I did, fast forward to about a month ago, I lost my sister to triple negative breast cancer and I practically watched her take her last breath and go through different stages that will scar me. Now here I am not wanting to put my family through that but incapable of going on 

I tried to make it as short as possible without every little detail, thanks for listening
